text:
Marcus: thanks everyone — quick live-thread after today's all-hands. follow-ups on runtime perf, batching/caching, kernel work. drop short Qs and we'll respond.
Priya: first Q — kernel v4 canary: what's the expected perf delta for short requests (<1k tokens)? any memory or correctness regressions we should watch for?
Ava: SLO question: for Dedicated customers, if we increase batching, do we risk p99 spikes? Example numbers appreciated.
Diego: quantization question — 4-bit path looks promising for cost. can we quantify quality delta on instruction-following and codegen evals?
Priya: short answers: v4 aims for ~10-18% p50 token speedup on A100 for common seq lengths; memory slightly down due to fused kernels. no correctness regressions in unit tests; canary will run eval set. rollout plan:
```
canary:
  stage: smoke -> 10% -> 50% -> full
  checks: [p50_latency, p99_tail, eval_regressions]
  rollback_on: eval_drop>1.5% or p99>1.5x
```
Priya: we'll attach the exact perf table in the follow-up doc, but expect better throughput for long-seq workloads and modest wins for short seq.
deploy-bot: :rocket: canary deployed for kernel/v4-canary at commit 9f2d3a — dashboard: https://deploys.redwood/kernels/v4/canary
Ava: thanks. for SLOs, suggestion: keep per-customer batching cap + dynamic batch timeout. e.g. default batch_timeout=8ms and max_batch=64. how does that map to latency p99?
Priya: agreed. initial defaults: batch_timeout=8ms, max_batch=32 for hosted. Dedicated customers can override. we observed p99 bump mainly when batch_timeout > 20ms.
Tanya: what's timeline for Private (VPC/on-prem) to get kernel v4? customers asking about compatibility with older CUDA stacks.
Priya: Private targets next month for vetted clusters; we'll provide pre-built containers for CUDA 11.8 + 12.1, and fallback kernels for older drivers.
Diego: on quant evals — I'll run the codegen + instruct eval harness with 4-bit profile and post numbers. expected quality delta <1.5% on codebench but we'll verify.
Marcus: owners: Priya -> kernel rollout, Diego -> quant evals, Ava -> SLO tuning for Dedicated. I'll follow up with a short doc and action items.
Marcus: if folks have short follow-ups, reply here. longer items we'll move to GH issues. thx :heart: 
Priya: pinging @Marcus for the final canary thresholds and who signs off on full rollout.
Marcus: I'll sign off when p50 improves and eval_drop<1%. aiming for full rollout in 3 weeks if canary healthy.
